mapper.sql:
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(pt.value, E'
' ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_values_text, string_agg(pt.label_en, E'
' ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_labels_en_text, string_agg(pt.label_zh, E'
' ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_labels_zh_text FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE assignment.problem_id = p.id ) normalized_tags ON TRUE

where.if: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE assignment.problem_id = p.id AND pt.value = #{tag} AND pt.active = TRUE )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM problem_category_item pci JOIN problem_category pc ON pc.id = pci.category_id WHERE pci.problem_id = p.id AND (pc.slug = #{category} OR pc.name = #{category}) )

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM problem p
ORDER BY p.frontend_id DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.title_en ASC, p.frontend_id ASC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.title_zh ASC, p.frontend_id ASC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY company_frequency_score DESC NULLS LAST, company_signal_count DESC, p.frontend_id ASC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.frontend_id ASC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.frontend_id, p.frontend_display_id, p.title_en, p.title_zh, p.difficulty, COALESCE(normalized_tags.tag_values_text, '') AS tag_values_text, COALESCE(normalized_tags.tag_labels_en_text, '') AS tag_labels_en_text, COALESCE(normalized_tags.tag_labels_zh_text, '') AS tag_labels_zh_text, p.content_markdown_en, p.content_markdown_zh, p.content_status, p.leetcode_url, p.sample_test_case, p.python3_template, p.source_commit, p.recommendation_reason_en, p.recommendation_reason_zh, NULL::NUMERIC AS company_frequency_score, 0::BIGINT AS company_signal_count FROM problem p
WHERE p.slug = #{slug}
SELECT p.difficulty AS value, p.difficulty AS label, COUNT(*) AS problem_count FROM problem p WHERE p.difficulty IS NOT NULL AND p.difficulty != '' GROUP BY p.difficulty ORDER BY p.difficulty ASC

SELECT pt.value AS value, CASE WHEN #{locale} = 'en-US' THEN pt.label_en ELSE pt.label_zh END AS label, COUNT(assignment.problem_id) AS problem_count FROM problem_tag pt JOIN problem_tag_assignment assignment ON assignment.tag_id = pt.id WHERE pt.active = TRUE GROUP BY pt.id, pt.value, pt.label_en, pt.label_zh ORDER BY label ASC, pt.value ASC

SELECT pc.slug, pc.name, COUNT(pci.problem_id) AS problem_count FROM problem_category pc LEFT JOIN problem_category_item pci ON pci.category_id = pc.id GROUP BY pc.id, pc.slug, pc.name ORDER BY pc.name ASC, pc.slug ASC

SELECT c.slug AS value, MIN(c.name) AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT pcs.problem_id) AS problem_count FROM company c JOIN problem_company_signal pcs ON pcs.company_id = c.id GROUP BY c.slug ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pcs.problem_id) DESC, MIN(c.name) ASC, c.slug ASC
SELECT pcs.role AS value, pcs.role AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT pcs.problem_id) AS problem_count FROM problem_company_signal pcs GROUP BY pcs.role ORDER BY pcs.role ASC

SELECT pcs.recency_bucket AS value, pcs.recency_bucket AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT pcs.problem_id) AS problem_count FROM problem_company_signal pcs GROUP BY pcs.recency_bucket ORDER BY pcs.recency_bucket ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem ( slug, frontend_id, frontend_display_id, title_en, title_zh, difficulty, tag_values, tag_labels_en, tag_labels_zh, content_markdown_en, content_markdown_zh, content_status, source_site, leetcode_url, sample_test_case, python3_template, source_commit, recommendation_reason_en, recommendation_reason_zh, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{slug}, #{frontendId}, #{frontendDisplayId}, #{titleEn}, #{titleZh}, #{difficulty}, #{tagValues}, #{tagLabelsEn}, #{tagLabelsZh}, #{contentMarkdownEn}, #{contentMarkdownZh}, #{contentStatus}, #{sourceSite}, #{leetcodeUrl}, #{sampleTestCase}, #{python3Template}, #{sourceCommit}, #{recommendationReasonEn}, #{recommendationReasonZh}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET frontend_id = EXCLUDED.frontend_id, frontend_display_id = EXCLUDED.frontend_display_id, title_en = EXCLUDED.title_en, title_zh = EXCLUDED.title_zh, difficulty = EXCLUDED.difficulty, tag_values = EXCLUDED.tag_values, tag_labels_en = EXCLUDED.tag_labels_en, tag_labels_zh = EXCLUDED.tag_labels_zh, content_markdown_en = EXCLUDED.content_markdown_en, content_markdown_zh = EXCLUDED.content_markdown_zh, content_status = EXCLUDED.content_status, source_site = EXCLUDED.source_site, leetcode_url = EXCLUDED.leetcode_url, sample_test_case = EXCLUDED.sample_test_case, python3_template = EXCLUDED.python3_template, source_commit = EXCLUDED.source_commit, recommendation_reason_en = EXCLUDED.recommendation_reason_en, recommendation_reason_zh = EXCLUDED.recommendation_reason_zh, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ( problem.frontend_id, problem.frontend_display_id, problem.title_en, problem.title_zh, problem.difficulty, problem.tag_values, problem.tag_labels_en, problem.tag_labels_zh, problem.content_markdown_en, problem.content_markdown_zh, problem.content_status, problem.source_site, problem.leetcode_url, problem.sample_test_case, problem.python3_template, problem.source_commit, problem.recommendation_reason_en, problem.recommendation_reason_zh ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.frontend_id, EXCLUDED.frontend_display_id, EXCLUDED.title_en, EXCLUDED.title_zh, EXCLUDED.difficulty, EXCLUDED.tag_values, EXCLUDED.tag_labels_en, EXCLUDED.tag_labels_zh, EXCLUDED.content_markdown_en, EXCLUDED.content_markdown_zh, EXCLUDED.content_status, EXCLUDED.source_site, EXCLUDED.leetcode_url, EXCLUDED.sample_test_case, EXCLUDED.python3_template, EXCLUDED.source_commit, EXCLUDED.recommendation_reason_en, EXCLUDED.recommendation_reason_zh )
